user_authorization: Direct user instruction: make the complete video Public and delete the episode images, video, and source assets because the release is finished.

eligibility.stage_27: User issued the explicit final-release instruction for the current release step.

writers.process_scan: No active episode render/writer process found; only the process performing the scan matched its pattern.

dependency_scope.root_text_search: Outside the episode, only the Paper playlist registry references the episode/video ID; no image, audio or render file paths were found.
dependency_scope.retirement_decision: Retire all episode-owned image/audio/render dependencies and completed local timelines together. No other-work consumer or shared media file is identified in the bounded scan. Preserve the current native YouTube title/thumbnail experiment; its variants are already configured in Studio and do not depend on local files.

retained: All regular text records and text configurations, including scripts/narration, research notes, visual bible/prompts/manifests, scene/edit plans, alignments, subtitles, metadata, A/B concepts, IDs/URLs, rights/provenance, hashes and prior receipts. Keep the .agents path and MediaLifecycle text archive.
limitations: The auditor coverage is bounded, not proof against every possible external consumer.
Physical APFS space reclaimed is unknown until the filesystem reports it; snapshots or copy-on-write clones may retain blocks.
Deleted generated images/audio are not guaranteed to be reproducible byte-for-byte.
execution: Authorized now; before each unlink verify recorded device/inode/size/mtime/ctime/nlink and SHA-256; delete only these enumerated files. Then remove empty episode-owned media directories and write the completion receipt.
